sections.title: Everyday Requests and Offers
sections.content:
Combine *poder* with pronouns to request favors or offer your assistance:
- **¿Me puedes ayudar?**: Can you help me?
- **¿Me haces un favor?**: Will you do me a favor?
- **¿Te puedo ayudar?**: Can I help you?
- **¿En qué puedo ayudarle?**: How may I help you? (formal)

sections.title: Polite Responses
rows: I'm sorry, I can't right now.
Thank you very much for your help.

items.spanish: ¿Me puedes pasar la sal, por favor?
items.english: Can you pass me the salt, please?
Can I help you with the bags?

sections.content: Attaching pronouns: You can say *¿Me puedes ayudar?* or *¿Puedes ayudarme?*. Both are 100% natural and common.
